title: competition_ranks ported line-for-line into client demo_store with no sync pin and untested tie branch
detail: Line-for-line port of the server's tie-sensitive ranking algorithm into the client demo package. Nothing pins the copies together: the client copy's tie branch is never exercised (demo scores all distinct), and the pub fn has no external caller.
recommended_fix: Move both functions to shared/leaderboard.gleam (server handler and client demo_store already import it) and delete the copies; short of that, add a client tie-semantics test mirroring competition_ranks_shared_for_ties_test.

title: Flags/positives screen↔PDF mirror pinned on the PDF side only; demo_store copy is unpinned
evidence:
server/test/demo/pdf_prebake_test.gleam:5-8: `//// canonical values and fail when EITHER side drifts: a fixture edit that
//// isn't mirrored in the payloads (or vice versa) breaks the pin.` — but the test body (line 73 and line 275) only reads `  list.each(pdf_prebake.payloads(), fn(p) {`. The mirrored client copy exists at client/src/demo/demo_store.gleam:215: `        "[{\"label\":\"Landlord reference letter is undated - recency cannot be confirmed\",\"severity\":\"amber\",\"category\":\"rental_history\"},...]"` and grep of client/test/demo finds zero assertions on flags/positives (sole hit is the comment `/// A demo-mode model: demo flag on, store seeded, mock landlord authed.`).
detail: The pin claims to catch drift in either copy but only reads pdf_prebake.payloads(). demo_store.analysis_for's mirrored arrays render on-screen via application_detail_ai.gleam and have zero client-test assertions — client-side drift ships silently.
recommended_fix: Add a client test asserting demo_store's per-applicant flags/positives equal the same canonical embedded lists used by pdf_prebake_test's canonical_flags/canonical_positives.

title: Demo evidence source labels bypass evidence_humanize's controlled label table
evidence:
server/src/demo/pdf_report_data.gleam:185-190: `            ev_kv(
              "Pay slips",
              "Gross income",
              "€4,850 per month (Aoife, Finlay Digital Ltd)",
              "high",
            ),` and line 192 `              "Employer reference",` — whereas the real pipeline renders labels exclusively via server/src/ai/evidence_humanize.gleam:103-104: `    "payslip" -> "Payslip"
    "employer_letter" -> "Employer letter"`; demo-only labels like "Application on file" have no table entry.
detail: Demo evidence sources are hand-invented labels ("Pay slips", "Application on file") rather than drawn from evidence_humanize's controlled table that real reports render through — demo PDFs' evidence vocabulary diverges from real-report styling.
recommended_fix: Use evidence_humanize's label vocabulary ("Payslip", "Employer letter") for ev/ev_kv source strings, or document the divergence as intentional demo craft.
